mentions.name: Camp in Japan
mentions.description: A service offering custom trip planning for vanlife adventures in Japan. It features articles, a section where people can post second-hand vehicles, and a paid "plus" plan that gives access to previously created custom trip plans.
mentions.problem: The biggest pain point is sending customers to sleep in remote spots responsibly; the author has refused about 50% of prospective customers based on early conversations, uncomfortable sending young, noisy travelers to spots where local volunteers clean the public spaces.
mentions.audience: Travelers doing vanlife trips in Japan who want custom trip plans
mentions.source_excerpt:
Since last month, I'm still working on https://www.campinjapan.com/

I had a few customers for custom trip planning for vanlife in Japan.
